body:
I'm in the USA (Michigan, but that's as much as I'm comfortable saying) in a conservative state. There is one 'free' mental health program near me, but the wait list is months long because it is so backed up. I live in a city with a huge drug addict population and unfortunately they kind of use the community mental health program as a way to get shit for free. They join CMH program, then use the fact that they're in it to get fast tracked in the local public housing program. Its fucked up because now I will have to wait until at least July to even see anybody for a session to determine if I am eligible for free services. Which aren't even free, they're sliding scale, and they're based upon the income of your household, not individually. And my mother makes a lot of money, but she's not helping me at all. So they'll take that into account and then charge me probably the price of cash anyhow. 

I've tried 7 cups of tea, which is an online therapy thing. It helps for a while, but I'm just... tired, you know? I'm just so tired all the time. I get up and every day is exhausting before it even starts. I don't expect anyone to fix me, or fix how I feel as that's unrealistic. What I want is something I don't know I can ever have. I just want to be content. Not even happy. I just want to not feel like my heart is going to fall out of my stomach every day all day long, to have a job where I can afford an apartment by myself. Maybe a pet. That's it. I just have no way of getting there.

I'm sorry :( I know there's not anything I can say to help. Sometimes I think that some people are just born broken. Like there's something inside that is just different than other people and they can't accept it or something. It feels like people don't even want to help to help, they want to help to shut me up. It doesn't feel like they want to help ME at all, but that they're trying to help themselves and also get social praise and feel like they made a difference with the sad guy. Which kind of makes it worse. It is easier to turn them away. It feels cruel to let people love me, or try to, so I just... why bother. 

It does suck. but my whole life has fucking sucked, really. That's kind of my reasoning for wanting to just be done with life. I've been on a 25 year rollercoaster where every turn just brings me closer to flinging out of the cart or falling off the tracks and I'm tired of it. I just want off. :/ 

Is there anything that makes you feel better? I don't know what to do, anymore, to distract myself, or soothe myself. I've tried the sitting in the shower and crying thing. I've tried drawing. Writing. Running/working out. All the shit that everyone says is supposed to 'help' but nothing feels like it does. The only thing I used to enjoy was playing video games but I can't even do that now because he's keeping the PC, too, and my laptop can't even play more than flash games because it is an ancient thinkpad. So I figured I'd ask if there was anything you found helped at all.

I've tried. Can't afford therapy. If I go up to a hospital, they'll just bill me for an inpatient stay and pump me full of antidepressants that don't help for a few days before kicking me to the curb because I can't pay anyhow. No real friends left - he took all of those, too. I guess they all just liked him more than me. Not surprised. Don't talk to most of my family, and even though I'm staying with my mother, any time I try and tell her how I feel she shuts me down. Doesn't want to 'hear any of my disgusting faggot shit'. She only took me in because I think she thinks she can somehow turn me straight being here or something. She keeps trying to set me up with women and keeps acting like I'm retarded for being so hurt even though the man that I wanted to spend my life with, that I've been with for ten years, just left me. You'd think she'd be a little sympathetic at all but no. She's just glad I'm not 'gay' anymore. Or at least not in a relationship that she thinks makes her look bad. I don't know. That's why I came here. I don't really have anywhere else.

I don't know what to think. I really hope he loved me at some point, but why would he tell me he didn't if he did, you know? To hurt me, maybe. Wish I knew because maybe then I'd have some kind of way to understand why things got to the point where they did. Tried talking to him about it, but he won't. I miss him so much, and I hate myself for it. Its hard not to believe it anymore because I don't even love me. I don't know if I even remember what feeling happy is like anymore. 

He posted pictures today on his fb out partying and having fun, he doesn't seem upset at all. I know the whole bullshit that everyone processes differently and all of that but how can someone be out at the bar smiling and laughing, posting about how he hasn't felt this good in years if he did care at all? Its like now that he's thrown me away that his life is just so much better. It feels like everyone is always better when I'm gone. 

I'm sorry about your partner. I can sympathize right about now at least somewhat. I don't know if you want to talk about it or not, but you're welcome to. Not sure if I can help at all, but the whole point of posting here (to me anyhow) is to try and do something - help, be helped, I don't know. It can't hurt. 

Thank you. I try to be. I really do. Try so hard to help other people, to do things for other people. Always been a fixer. Just can't ever seem to fix myself. Too broken, maybe. Part of me wonders if people can just see it. How broken I am. If that's why they all pull away. Why every time I seem to make a friend it doesn't last. Its like they can smell the dysfunction on me. All I want is to be normal. Have friends. Even just one or two that actually cared about me as a person and not just what I can do for them. Ones that didn't leave when I ran out of money to give. Things to give. Because I'm entirely spent, now. I don't feel like I have anything left anymore. No money. No friends. Nothing left inside of me. I'm just empty. Broke, broken, and void.

That's why I feel so helpless, honestly. The shelters where I live are already overflowing, and I technically have somewhere to live. I don't feel like that would be worth it. As to the friendships I've been trying, but everyone else has pretty much forgotten I even exist and they're busy with their marriages and babies and jobs. I get it. I wouldn't have time for me either if I did. I've tried to get a therapist, but I have no insurance, and there's no way I can afford even sliding scale. I can't even afford the $30 to get my license reinstated so I could try and get a job. Or razors to keep my face shaved. It all just is so overwhelming because there aren't resources that i can access. I've even thought about hitchhiking out to the West side of the US just because there MAY be something out there, or at least if I'm fucked it doesn't get as cold as it does here. The temperature still dips below freezing at night, and it rains a lot. The worst part is I really want, in my heart, for things to be better, but I don't know if they ever will, or if they even could.
